decision.reason: [ev-3c259372f6bf] supports the change type: cluster name validation can no longer be bypassed, and names must be at most 32 lower case alphanumeric characters or '-', starting and ending with an alphanumeric character. That is validation-tightened. The subject is not supported, though. The excerpt only says "cluster name" and never names a configuration key, Helm value or flag, so the config-key path "cluster-name" is an inferred identifier, not one copied from the evidence. To settle the subject we need evidence that names the setting that carries the cluster name, such as the config key, Helm value or CLI flag and the component that owns it.
